correctness.rationale: For atomless iid values, Stuart’s diagonal rank–value covariance is (N−1)G/4. A constant rank sum forces every off-diagonal to −G/4; contraction against any deterministic zero-sum c gives NG||c||²/4, and the permutation-rank variance is N(N+1)||c||²/12. Combining gives the claimed common correlation and the Mann–Whitney two-sample identity. Sharp Gini bound follows from Cauchy–Schwarz between X and F(X); equality iff X is affine in F(X), i.e. uniform on interval. Independently exactly enumerated uniform order-rank conditional expectations for N=3,4,5, recovering expected covariances 2,20/3,50/3 for centered arithmetic contrasts. The final RESULT.md has a form-feed character corrupting one displayed LaTex command in the sample specialization, but the intended identity is otherwise unambiguous.
